source: Previously downloaded official xcresult ZIPs; SHA-256 rechecked before extraction. JSON events exported with /usr/bin/log show --style json --info --debug --timezone UTC. Attachment timestamp and row JSON exported with xcrun xcresulttool export attachments.
selection: Full archive export (log show start/end returned no events); UTC filtering done in Python. Keep coreaudiod AMCP/carc, Overload or AVIODevice messages, and yl_player_example AMCP, Engine@ or setPlayState Started messages. Deduplicate exact projected records. All eventMessage strings are preserved as exported, including system redaction/truncation.
limitations: Temporal association between a test row and its engine start, not a shared tap-to-HAL host-time anchor.
No host CPU or hypervisor scheduler trace was collected.
System clock warnings can occur in passing rows; individual warning presence is not a loss criterion.
Diagnostic cause labels and fields are system observations, not proof of a host CPU root cause.
